integrity: The fifth-order Fourier recurrence is fully specified and its positive sign certified by reproducible integer outward intervals; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to local small-amplitude branch at zero bulk degradation and critical cubic coefficient; stability and global cycle structure are not determined. Analytic branch existence is cited from Pelz–Scheel.
title: Positive fifth-order unfolding at the degenerate diffusive-boundary Hopf point
